description_sq:
Ofrohen apartamente moderne 2+1/1+1 per shitje prane Rruges se Barrikadave.
Apartamentet jane pjese e nje pallati te ri me ashensore prane shkolles Servete Maci, ndodhet ne katin 5, Planimetri fillestare ne nje apartamente por i ndare tashme ne 2 apartamente te pavarura. Apartamentet jane totalisht te restauruar edhe te investuar ne detaje me rifinitura luksoze, Aktulishte jane te dhena me qira mujore 1,900 Euro/ muaj.
Ideale per banime edhe jo vetem.
Per me shume detaje edhe nje vizite ne prone jeni te lutur te na konktaktoni!
title_en: Apartment 2+1/1+1 for sale in the Center!
description_en: Modern 2+1/1+1 apartments are available for sale near the Barricades Street. The apartments are part of a new building with an elevator near the Servete Maci school, located on the 5th floor, the initial floor plan in one apartment but now divided into 2 independent apartments. The apartments have been completely restored and invested in details with luxurious refinishing, they are currently rented monthly for 1,900 Euros/month. Ideal for residences and not only. For more details and a visit to the property, please contact us!
